problems: From about the middle of the film to the end (frames 9-16 of the storyboard, the 50% and 75% stills), the picture is almost entirely black with only faint dark outlines. That is about 4.5 s of nothing to look at, and a viewer cannot tell it is the inside of a tree. The darkness reads as a dead or corrupted video, not as the camera having ended up in a trunk.

The caption says 'filming the echo at two places', but the film shows only one place that you can see. The second place is the black stretch, so the 'two places' claim cannot be checked from the pictures.

In the first half (storyboard frames 2-8, 25% still), nobody claps and no echo or 'ear' is shown. The view stays nearly still on four yellow planks standing in a pond, with cattails in front, while a sheep wanders in the background. Nothing on screen points to sound, so the title 'The island answers a clap' is never shown, not even as an attempt.
Storyboard frame 1: a big yellow bird and a purple post are cut off at the frame edge and stand right against the camera. The camera then jumps away without a cause, so the opening is confusing.
25% still: cattail stalks on the right sit in the foreground and cover part of the scene. The planks are the biggest thing in the picture, but their meaning is never explained.
posts.critique: As a failure post it doesn't come across as a failure: half the film is an unreadable black screen, and the half you can see shows no clap, no echo and no second place. The caption is the only thing telling us what went wrong, and the pictures never back it up.
